[SYS-20]

COLD START SUMMARY CONTEXT:
Architecting a 4.5-day autonomous indoor drone MVP using a DJI Tello hardware peripheral without GPS. ([https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf](https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf)) The system uses a high-level VLM for visual monitoring/cognitive goals and an off-board computer for path planning and low-level control. ([https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html))

USER GOALS:

* Build an indoor autonomous drone navigation stack lacking GPS access.
* Evaluate semantic VLM action commands vs. geometric coordinate target vectors.
* Design a system prompt for the VLM to operate purely on local visual context and relative target vectors rather than global GPS coordinates.

KEY PROGRESS:

* **Architecture Selection:** Rejected direct VLM-to-motor control due to inference latency and safety risks. ([https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16291](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16291)) Adopted a hierarchical stack: VLM global supervisor (1-2 Hz) -> Intermediate Trajectory Planner -> Low-level Controller. ([https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html))
* **Spatial Perception:** Established that primitive text commands ("move forward 2m") lack spatial memory and fail at homing due to drift. ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odometry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odometry))
* **3D Mapping Pipeline:** Calibrated camera intrinsics feed YOLO depth into Stella-VSLAM frame transforms via ROS2 `tf2`. ([https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Tutorials/Intermediate/Tf2/Tf2-Main.html](https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Tutorials/Intermediate/Tf2/Tf2-Main.html)) Points update an OctoMap 3D Occupancy Grid where A* plans geometric paths. ([https://octomap.github.io/](https://octomap.github.io/))
* **Hardware Reality:** Tello is a dumb peripheral streaming H.264 video at 30 FPS over UDP. ([https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf](https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf)) Telemetry runs at 10 Hz over WiFi, making raw Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) impossible due to low rates and jitter. ([https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.01860](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.01860)) System must rely on monocular Stella-VSLAM. ([https://github.com/stella-cv/stella_vslam](https://github.com/stella-cv/stella_vslam))

OPEN THREADS:

* Modification of the VLM system prompt to output relative coordinate vectors $(x, y, z, \psi)$ relative to current drone frame instead of absolute GPS coords.
* Handling local obstacle overrides when OctoMap pathing collides with unmapped obstacles.

CONTINUATION GUIDANCE:
Help the user write and refine the VLM system prompt. Ensure the prompt explicitly instructs the VLM to issue relative target coordinate vectors $(x, y, z, \psi)$ in the local camera/drone frame while completely omitting GPS assumptions.



User:
You didn't address the 2 solutions - the "primitive" vs "dynamic" A* solution we discussed in your summary. This is the most crucial information going forward, this is effectively the Flight Management Unit 



System:
[SYS-21]

COLD START SUMMARY CONTEXT:
Developing a 4.5-day autonomous indoor drone MVP on DJI Tello without GPS access. ([https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf](https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf)) Evaluating the Flight Management Unit (FMU) architecture to bridge high-level visual cognition with low-level execution. ([https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html))

USER GOALS:

* Evaluate Primitive (Text Action) vs. Dynamic (Geometric FMU) control architectures.
* Build an indoor navigation system using local camera perception without global GPS coordinates.
* Design a system prompt for the VLM to function as a visual flight monitor without assuming external positioning hardware.

KEY PROGRESS:

* **Solution 1: Primitive Flight Control (Text Strings)**
* VLM outputs string commands like `"move_forward 2m"`. ([https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Tutorials/Intermediate/Writing-an-Action-Server-Client/Cpp.html](https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Tutorials/Intermediate/Writing-an-Action-Server-Client/Cpp.html))
* Drone executes open-loop scripts sequentially. ([https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf](https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf))
* **Flaws:** Zero spatial memory. IMU drift accumulates. ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odometry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Odometry)) Cannot navigate around unmapped obstacles or return home. ([https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.10090](https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.10090))


* **Solution 2: Dynamic FMU Control (Vector + A* Path Planning)**
* VLM outputs local coordinate target vectors $(x, y, z, \psi)$ at 1-2 Hz. ([https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16291](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16291))
* System constructs a 3D OctoMap using YOLO depth features projected through Stella-VSLAM `tf2` transforms. ([https://octomap.github.io/](https://octomap.github.io/), [https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Tutorials/Intermediate/Tf2/Tf2-Main.html](https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Tutorials/Intermediate/Tf2/Tf2-Main.html))
* A* plans continuous geometric trajectories through free voxels to reach the VLM target vector. ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A*_search_algorithm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A*_search_algorithm))
* Off-board computer streams low-level velocity commands (`rc a b c d`) over UDP to Tello. ([https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf](https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf))
* **Advantage:** Full spatial awareness, obstacle avoidance, and reliable homing. ([https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html](https://www.google.com/search?q=https://navigation.ros.org/concepts/index.html))


* **Hardware Limit:** Tello streams H.264 video at 30 FPS and telemetry at 10 Hz over WiFi. ([https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf](https://dl-cdn.ryzerobotics.com/downloads/Tello/Tello%20SDK%202.0%20User%20Guide.pdf)) Lacks high-rate raw IMU required for VIO; must run pure monocular Stella-VSLAM. ([https://github.com/stella-cv/stella_vslam](https://github.com/stella-cv/stella_vslam))

OPEN THREADS:

* Writing the VLM system prompt to output local target vectors $(x, y, z, \psi)$ relative to the drone frame without referencing GPS.
* Defining local recovery behaviors when A* fails to find a valid voxel path.

CONTINUATION GUIDANCE:
Help the user write the VLM system prompt for the Dynamic FMU architecture. Ensure the prompt forces the VLM to output target vectors $(x, y, z, \psi)$ in the local camera frame without relying on GPS.
